protocol.estimand: Entries into focal state on branches from fixed focal-sample MRCA to those samples
protocol.inference: Existing fixed-tree ER CTMC, Gamma(1,1) off-diagonal-rate prior
limitations: Small smoke runs cannot establish calibration or optimal quotas.
Validation seeds are disjoint; these results must not be used to tune a claimed held-out validation.
No structured-coalescent, tree/dating uncertainty, unsampled-deme model, or real surveillance validation.
Diversification is trait-independent; this is not an epidemic simulator.
protocol.protocol_status: Prespecified engineering benchmark; quota recommendations withheld
protocol.tree: Known dated branching trees, preserved unary nodes; no sequence-to-tree estimation
